functions.limitations: Archive opening, original flags and write mode are excluded; portable API differs.

functions.limitations: Supported-subset behavioral reconstruction with different error handling and extra bounds checks; not the complete original function.

functions.coverage: Frame-kind names for the 16 supported numeric kinds.
functions.limitations: The original formatted unknown-value fallback is excluded; an empty optional replaces it.

functions.coverage: Model-file header checks plus bounded first-table flag/record traversal.
functions.limitations: Engine allocation, global state, resource requests, subsequent frame records, opaque-field meanings and complete model loading are not reconstructed.
